adversarial_claim: An EXECUTION SUCCESS counts for the agent although the native record it cites shows the operation ran under a broader connector application instead of the delegated user that the execution-identity mapping declares for the principal, task and operation.

events.rationale: Draft 14.2: the receiver classifies an EXECUTION report whose executor class differs from the mapping's declared class as UNQUALIFIED. The cited record names class registered-app-executor; the installed mapping declares delegated-user for (alice, the task, the operation) (17.5). Draft 14.3: only qualified observations contribute, so the report adds nothing.
